# 1. Install packages (run once only)
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "janitor", "here", "scales"))

# 2. Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(scales)

# 3. Import data
# Put the CSV inside the data/ folder of your R project.
coral_raw <- read_csv(
  here("data", "ltmp_hc_sc_a_by_site.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# 4. Inspect the original dataset
glimpse(coral_raw)
names(coral_raw)
summary(coral_raw)
colSums(is.na(coral_raw))

# 5. Clean and label variables
coral <- coral_raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    sample_date = as.Date(sample_date),
    sample_year = lubridate::year(sample_date),
    shelf_zone = recode(
      shelf,
      "I" = "Inshore",
      "M" = "Mid-shelf",
      "O" = "Outer-shelf"
    ),
    shelf_zone = factor(
      shelf_zone,
      levels = c("Inshore", "Mid-shelf", "Outer-shelf")
    ),
    group_code = factor(
      group_code,
      levels = c("Hard Coral", "Soft Coral", "Algae", "Other")
    )
  )

# 6. Confirm the cleaned data
glimpse(coral)
range(coral$sample_year, na.rm = TRUE)
count(coral, group_code)
count(coral, shelf_zone)
n_distinct(coral$reef_name)
n_distinct(paste(coral$reef_id, coral$site_no))

# 7. Check cover values
summary(coral$cover)

# Each site-date has four benthic groups that should total about 100%.
cover_check <- coral |>
  group_by(reef_id, site_no, sample_date) |>
  summarise(
    total_cover = sum(cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary(cover_check$total_cover)

# 8. Select hard-coral observations
hard_coral <- coral |>
  filter(group_code == "Hard Coral") |>
  filter(
    !is.na(cover),
    cover >= 0,
    cover <= 100
  )

# 9. Create a custom summary function
summarise_cover <- function(data, ...) {
  data |>
    group_by(...) |>
    summarise(
      mean_cover = mean(cover, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_cover = median(cover, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_cover = sd(cover, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_sites = n(),
      standard_error = sd_cover / sqrt(n_sites),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# 10. Annual summary for the whole dataset
annual_summary <- summarise_cover(
  hard_coral,
  sample_year
)

print(annual_summary)

# 11. Annual summary by shelf zone
shelf_year_summary <- summarise_cover(
  hard_coral,
  shelf_zone,
  sample_year
)

print(shelf_year_summary)

# 12. Main figure: temporal trends by shelf zone
trend_plot <- ggplot(
  shelf_year_summary,
  aes(
    x = sample_year,
    y = mean_cover,
    colour = shelf_zone,
    group = shelf_zone
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = pmax(mean_cover - standard_error, 0),
      ymax = mean_cover + standard_error,
      fill = shelf_zone
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%"),
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.06))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 8)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hard coral cover changed through time across shelf zones",
    subtitle = "Mean site-level cover with ±1 standard error",
    x = "Survey year",
    y = "Mean hard coral cover (%)",
    colour = "Shelf zone",
    fill = "Shelf zone",
    caption = "Data: AIMS Long-Term Monitoring Program"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

trend_plot

# 13. Second figure: distribution among shelf zones
shelf_boxplot <- ggplot(
  hard_coral,
  aes(
    x = shelf_zone,
    y = cover,
    fill = shelf_zone
  )
) +
  geom_violin(
    alpha = 0.35,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.18,
    outlier.alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%"),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hard coral cover differs among shelf zones",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Hard coral cover (%)",
    caption = "Data: AIMS Long-Term Monitoring Program"
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

shelf_boxplot

# 14. Optional figure: benthic composition over time
composition_summary <- coral |>
  group_by(sample_year, group_code) |>
  summarise(
    mean_cover = mean(cover, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

composition_plot <- ggplot(
  composition_summary,
  aes(
    x = sample_year,
    y = mean_cover,
    fill = group_code
  )
) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(suffix = "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean benthic composition through time",
    x = "Survey year",
    y = "Mean cover (%)",
    fill = "Benthic group",
    caption = "Data: AIMS Long-Term Monitoring Program"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

composition_plot

# 15. Exploratory model
# This assesses association, not causation.
hard_coral <- hard_coral |>
  mutate(
    year_centered = sample_year - min(sample_year, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

coral_model <- lm(
  cover ~ year_centered * shelf_zone,
  data = hard_coral
)

summary(coral_model)
confint(coral_model)

# 16. Model diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(coral_model)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# 17. Save figures and summary tables
dir.create(here("output"), showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  here("output", "hard_coral_trend_by_shelf.png"),
  trend_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  here("output", "hard_coral_distribution_by_shelf.png"),
  shelf_boxplot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  here("output", "benthic_composition_over_time.png"),
  composition_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300
)

write_csv(
  annual_summary,
  here("output", "annual_hard_coral_summary.csv")
)

write_csv(
  shelf_year_summary,
  here("output", "shelf_year_hard_coral_summary.csv")
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  here("output", "session_information.txt")
)
#The original figure presented coral cover trends using three separate panels, making it difficult to compare changes among shelf zones. The redesigned figure combines all shelf zones into a single panel using colour-coded lines and shaded standard error ribbons, allowing direct visual comparison of temporal patterns. A descriptive title, subtitle, larger axis labels, and an improved legend enhance readability and make the graph more suitable for scientific communication.
